2. User Personas • Students (JEE/GATE/NEET aspirants): Typically high-school (17–18 yrs) or graduate (21+ yrs) students. They want clear, focused preparation material for Physics, Chemistry, Math and (for NEET) Biology, mapped to exam syllabus. They value mobile/online access, self-paced learning, and interactive assessments. We will support user journeys like “review Chapter X, watch video, take quiz, review mistakes.” • Teachers/Tutors: Education professionals preparing content or monitoring students. They need tools to assign topics, track class progress, and generate new materials. They might use the portal to supplement in-class teaching, or to personalize tasks. Executive Summary We propose an AI-driven education portal for JEE/GATE/NEET that offers automatically generated video lectures, topic-wise notes, quizzes, and question banks, supported by teacher and administrator interfaces. Core features include AI-produced instructional videos (with synthesized speech and optional avatar), dynamically created summaries/notes, customizable test series, and a robust question-answer engine. Additional features could include adaptive learning paths, student analytics dashboards, peer Q&A forums, and gamification elements. All content will be strictly constrained to the relevant syllabus through a layered safety system (rules, classifiers, and possible reinforcement learning fine-tuning) to prevent off-topic or inappropriate output.
